  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the verse "Eichah yashvah badad" as referring to the descent of Israel into multiplicity and concealment, which paradoxically leads to the revelation of the level of "badad" above Seder Hishtalshelus through the service of Kabbalas Ol.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is “Eichah yashvah badad, the city great with people,”</t>
    <t s="2">“Eichah” is a question — that Israel, who were on the level of “am” (people),</t>
    <t s="3">“glowing coals that have become dim,” etc.</t>
    <t s="4">“and great with people”</t>
    <t s="5">(according to its simple meaning)</t>
    <t s="6">[means] the multiplicity of divisions, etc., and “great with opinions”</t>
    <t s="7">[means] the multiplicity of opinions,</t>
    <t s="8">“Da’as” and “De’os.”</t>
    <t s="9">For it is written,</t>
    <t s="10">“For G-d of opinions is Havayah”</t>
    <t s="11">(“opinions” is in the plural),</t>
    <t s="12">and it is known from the teaching of the Alter Rebbe</t>
    <t s="13">that they must be united together, and above that — that above and below are equal,</t>
    <t s="14">“G-d of opinions is Havayah” — which includes both opinions together,</t>
    <t s="15">behold she is “great with opinions,”</t>
    <t s="16">“Da’as” and “De’os” and in several modes.</t>
    <t s="17">“She became like a widow” — whose husband went to a country overseas,</t>
    <t s="18">the matter of “her husband” — is in concealment,</t>
    <t s="19">“great among the nations” — this is the matter of the investment in the matters of the seventy nations, etc.,</t>
    <t s="20">“princess among the provinces” — also the power of exaltation and strength is in the provinces,</t>
    <t s="21">“she became tributary.”</t>
    <t s="22">But all this is for the sake of elevation: “princess” [Sarasi] are the letters of “Tishrei,”</t>
    <t s="23">for then is the building of Malchus to be “princess among the provinces,”</t>
    <t s="24">“she became tributary” is the self-nullification of Kabbalas Ol,</t>
    <t s="25">for specifically during the time of concealment and hiding,</t>
    <t s="26">when she is “great with people,” etc., “princess among the provinces,”</t>
    <t s="27">behold, specifically then is the self-nullification of Kabbalas Ol,</t>
    <t s="28">“she became tributary,”</t>
    <t s="29">which is not an existence for itself, but is only “tributary.”</t>
    <t s="30">And it is known that the service in this exile, and particularly in the heels of Moshiach, is not in the aspect of the intellects nor in the aspect of the emotions, but rather the service of Kabbalas Ol</t>
    <t s="31">(and as mentioned above in the explanation of “the man Moshe was very humble”).</t>
    <t s="32">And specifically through this, “yashvah badad” is brought about,</t>
    <t s="33">the revelation of the aspect of “badad” which is above Seder Hishtalshelus,</t>
    <t s="34">“Yachid” (Singular),</t>
    <t s="35">which is above even the concealed Sefiros — in a manner of “yashvah” (settling).</t>
    <t s="36">And as explained by the Mitteler Rebbe</t>
    <t s="37">in the explanation of “You are One and not in number,”</t>
    <t s="38">that it is above even the concealed Sefiros.</t>
    <t s="39">And with this will be understood the mediation between the two explanations of “Eichah yashvah badad,”</t>
    <t s="40">the simple explanation and the explanation of the Tzemach Tzedek that it refers to the elevation and revelation of the aspect of “badad,”</t>
    <t s="41">for the revelation of the aspect of “badad” which is above Seder Hishtalshelus is specifically through the service of Kabbalas Ol during the time of exile,</t>
    <t s="42">as mentioned above.</t>
    <t s="43">And this is “Eichah yashvah badad,” etc., “Eichah” is an expression of wonder and astonishment,</t>
    <t s="44">that it will come from “great with people,”</t>
    <t s="45">“dim” and “great” in this, etc., to “badad” which is above Seder Hishtalshelus and in a manner of “yashvah” — this is a matter of wonder.</t>
    <t s="46">(And it can also be said that the revelation and settlement of the aspect of “badad” which is above Seder Hishtalshelus,</t>
    <t s="47">is not according to the order of Hishtalshelus,</t>
    <t s="48">above time and space.</t>
    <t s="49">And therefore also the service through which the revelation of the aspect of “badad” is drawn down,</t>
    <t s="50">is the matter of the service of Teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="51">for the matter of Teshuvah is the service that is above Seder Hishtalshelus in the soul of man).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the aspect of "badad" is specifically connected to Yaakov, representing the third line of service that brings about the ultimate revelation of the Third Beis HaMikdash, which is above even the state of Gan Eden before the sin.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And now, the connection of the aspect of “badad,”</t>
    <t s="2">the aspect of “Yachid,”</t>
    <t s="3">specifically to Yaakov</t>
    <t s="4">(as it is written, “He shall dwell alone, the eye of Yaakov”)</t>
    <t s="5">is,</t>
    <t s="6">for behold, it was explained above that “badad” is the aspect of Atik,</t>
    <t s="7">which is above the two lines, right and left,</t>
    <t s="8">and as the statement,</t>
    <t s="9">“And there is no left in this Atika,”</t>
    <t s="10">and therefore the revelation of this aspect is specifically through the service of the third line.</t>
    <t s="11">And as it is written, “Zion shall be redeemed with justice,” and the Tzemach Tzeddek explains</t>
    <t s="12">that “justice” is specifically with three,</t>
    <t s="13">etc., that is, Chesed, Gevurah, Tiferes.</t>
    <t s="14">And this means that the making of a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in a complete manner, is specifically through service in all three lines,</t>
    <t s="15">and as explained by my father-in-law, the Rebbe, in the Mishnah, “On three things the world stands,”</t>
    <t s="16">that through the service in the three lines,</t>
    <t s="17">Torah, service, and acts of kindness,</t>
    <t s="18">the world stands,</t>
    <t s="19">for the purpose of the creation of the world is completed.</t>
    <t s="20">And this is also the matter of the Third Beis HaMikdash,</t>
    <t s="21">the third line,</t>
    <t s="22">the aspect of “an inheritance without boundaries” of Yaakov,</t>
    <t s="23">in which will be</t>
    <t s="24">(also)</t>
    <t s="25">the inclusion of the First Beis HaMikdash and the Second Beis HaMikdash.</t>
    <t s="26">And this will be above even how it was in Gan Eden of old,</t>
    <t s="27">that is, even above how it was in Gan Eden before the sin,</t>
    <t s="28">and as is known regarding the matter of Adam and Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="29">that “Adam” is an acronym for Adam, Dovid, Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="30">and the combination is in the order Alef-Dalet-Mem — which indicates order, etc., unlike Moshiach, about whom it is written,</t>
    <t s="31">“Behold, My servant shall prosper, he shall be exalted and lifted up and very high,”</t>
    <t s="32">“very high” [Me’od] are the letters of Adam,</t>
    <t s="33">but in a combination that indicates without limit,</t>
    <t s="34">the opposite of the matter of the form of Adam.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the service in the present exile has a superiority over the future revelation, because it is the cause of that revelation and reflects the pleasure of the Creator Himself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And now, as stated above, the revelation of the future is drawn down specifically through the service of the present.</t>
    <t s="2">From this it is understood that there is a superiority in the service of the present over even the revelation of the future,</t>
    <t s="3">and as the Rebbe Maharash explains in the explanation of the Mishnah,</t>
    <t s="4">“One hour of repentance and good deeds in this world is more beautiful than all the life of the World to Come,”</t>
    <t s="5">for since the service in repentance and good deeds in this world is the cause of the life of the World to Come</t>
    <t s="6">(including also the revelations of the future)</t>
    <t s="7">behold, necessarily there is a superiority in the service of this world over the revelations of the future,</t>
    <t s="8">for the thing that causes is stronger than the thing that is brought about by it.</t>
    <t s="9">And also regarding the matter of pleasure,</t>
    <t s="10">that the aspect of “an inheritance without boundaries” of Yaakov is in the time of “Raa’va d’Raa’vin”</t>
    <t s="11">(the matter of pleasure),</t>
    <t s="12">there is a superiority specifically in the service of the present,</t>
    <t s="13">and as is explained there before this,</t>
    <t s="14">that the pleasure of the future is</t>
    <t s="15">(generally)</t>
    <t s="16">the pleasure of the created being, and the pleasure of repentance and good deeds in this world is</t>
    <t s="17">(generally)</t>
    <t s="18">the pleasure of the Creator,</t>
    <t s="19">“Pleasure before Me”</t>
    <t s="20">that I spoke and My will was done.</t>
  </section>
